title: 4DV Insight Software Buy
agency_path: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF.US CUSTOMS AND BORDER PROTECTION.BORDER ENFORCEMENT CONTRACTING DIVISION
detail_text: In accordance with FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No other Supplies or Services will satisfy agency requirements. Customs and Border Protection intends to negotiate a Sole Source Award with Business and Engineering Systems Corp, 20098 Ashbrook PL, STE 200, Ashburn, VA 20147 for 4DV Insight software licenses and engineering support for the USBP Headquarters Intelligence, 1300 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington DC 20004. Period of performance 9/30/2026 to 9/29/2027. The NAICS code for this procurement is 513210, Small Business size standard $41.5 Million. This notice of intent is not a request for quotations. No solicitation will be made available. Interested parties who wish to submit information about their companies' capabilities can email the contracting officer no later than 2:00 PM, ET, 2/25/2026. Information should be emailed to amoz.j.samuel@cbp.dhs.gov, no phone calls accepted.
